title: Typed processing graphs and offload planning
summary: Processing graphs are typed DAGs. External material geometry plus processor resource models plus precision policy derive node memory estimates, execution waves and graph placement requirements. Audio supplies requirements; the allocator owns eligibility, ranking and leases.
invariants: Graph edges are typed external or node-output port references and canonicalize deterministically.
Dispatch envelopes are value-only and contain no live runtime capabilities.
Concurrent wave memory is estimated conservatively and safety-margined.
GPU is an execution resource, not part of processor semantic identity.

provenance.claim: Typed DAG resource planning and value-only dispatch.
